integration-examples-main/Cargo.toml:
[workspace]
[package]
name = "integration-examples"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/SuperInstance/integration-examples"
authors = ["SuperInstance Team"]
description = "Integration examples showing how to use SuperInstance ecosystem tools together"
publish = false

[dependencies]
# Ecosystem tools (local path dependencies during development)
privox = { path = "../privox" }
tripartite-rs = { path = "../tripartite-rs" }
knowledge-vault = { path = "../knowledge-vault" }
hwscan = { path = "../hwscan" }
# Temporarily disabled due to dependency conflicts
# model-registry = { path = "../model-registry" }
# token-vault = { path = "../token-vault" }
# quicunnel = { path = "../quicunnel" }
# usemeter = { path = "../usemeter" }

# Async runtime
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }

# CLI
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] }

# Web framework
actix-web = "4"
actix-ws = "0.3"
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"

# Error handling
anyhow = "1"
thiserror = "1"

# Async trait
async-trait = "0.1"

# Logging
tracing = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["env-filter"] }

# Database - use workspace version to avoid conflicts
rusqlite = "0.30"

# HTTP
reqwest = { version = "0.12", features = ["json"] }

[dev-dependencies]
tokio-test = "0.4"
tempfile = "3"

[[bin]]
name = "basic_redactor"
path = "cli/basic_redactor.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "consensus_app"
path = "cli/consensus_app.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "knowledge_search"
path = "cli/knowledge_search.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "hw_info"
path = "cli/hw_info.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "redaction_api"
path = "web/redaction_api.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "consensus_ws"
path = "web/consensus_ws.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "search_api"
path = "web/search_api.rs"

[lib]
name = "integration_examples"
path = "lib/mod.rs"
